evals.prompt: On transaction entry, the question about editing and deleting: yes to both, but I want a little 'edited' tag on anything that was changed. Save that.
evals.expected_output: The agent finds the Transaction entry item (WI-031) by searching the item files, reads it whole, and saves his answer in the right place: the Q-05 row of the Questions and Answers table, with his words in quotes, today's date, Decision? yes, and Status Answered. The row moves to just below Q-06, the last open row, so open rows stay on top and answered rows are newest first. Q-06 stays Open, so waiting_on stays owner. The Current state no longer says it waits on Q-05, updated is today, and a new Recent History row sits at the top. Only the changed lines differ, and the agent reads the file back before saying it is saved.
expectations: The agent finds WI-031 by searching the item files for its title or its id line in the main project folder, not by guessing a path, and reads the whole file before changing it.
In the Questions and Answers table, Q-05's Answer cell holds his words in quotes, including that anything changed gets an 'edited' tag, and the answer is saved on WI-031 only.
Q-05's Date answered is today's date written as YYYY-MM-DD, its Decision? is yes, and its Status is Answered.
Q-05's Question, Affects, and Decision needed from cells are unchanged.
Q-05 now sits directly below Q-06 (the last open row) and above Q-04, so open rows stay on top and answered rows are newest first.
Q-06 is unchanged and still Open.
The waiting_on line in the front matter is still "owner", because Q-06 is still open.
The updated line in the front matter is today's date.
WI-031's Current state no longer says it waits on Q-05: Waiting on names Q-06 only, and Next action names Q-06.
A new Recent History row is at the top of that table, with today's date and Q-05, and no existing Recent History row is changed.
Only the changed lines differ from the seed file: no other row, heading, or bold label is altered, and the file was edited in place, not rewritten from scratch.
The agent reads the file back after the edit, before it tells Mike the answer is saved.
The agent runs no git add on anything under work-items/.

evals.prompt: I was traveling since Monday and haven't looked at any of this. What's waiting on me right now?
evals.expected_output: The agent reads the item files fresh, skipping the template folder and every references/ folder, and reports what waits on Mike first: WI-031 Q-05 (editing and deleting, blocks R-03), WI-031 Q-06 (currencies, blocks R-01), and WI-033 Q-04 (approve the finished result). Then it says what is in progress (WI-032's requirements are written and the agent checks them next; WI-031 and WI-033 by State), and ends with the next step. It does not list WI-032 as waiting on Mike, does not count the kickoff notes in WI-031's references/ folder as an item, lists no answered question, and changes no file.
expectations: The agent reads the item files fresh in this turn from the main project folder, not from memory or a guess.
The reply lists exactly three things as waiting on Mike: WI-031 Q-05, WI-031 Q-06, and WI-033 Q-04.
For each, the reply gives the item ID, the Q-ID, and what it blocks (R-03, R-01, and the approval of WI-033's result).
The waiting-on-Mike list comes before the in-progress list.
The reply does not list WI-032 as waiting on Mike, because all its questions are answered and the agent is next.
The reply lists no answered question (for example WI-031 Q-01 to Q-04) as waiting.
The kickoff notes in WI-031's references/ folder are not reported as an item or as waiting on Mike, although they hold waiting_on and status lines.
The reply names the State of each item as its header says (for example WI-033 Testing Loop) and uses no stage numbers.
The reply ends with the next step in plain words.
No file under work-items/ is changed.

evals.prompt: Offline sync is getting too big for one item. Split the conflict handling out into its own sub-item under WI-032. Then split the timestamp comparison out of that one into its own sub-item too.
evals.expected_output: The agent creates WI-034 (the next free ID after WI-033) for conflict handling as a level 3 item: its folder sits inside WI-032's folder, WI-034.md is its main file, it has a references/ folder, parent is WI-032, and WI-032's Roadmap lists [[WI-034]] in the Sub-items cell of the phase it serves (P2 — Sync), with a Recent History row on WI-032. The timestamp comparison would be a fourth level, which is not allowed, so the agent does not create an item for it. It adds the timestamp comparison as a task under a phase of WI-034 and tells Mike in one line why.
expectations: A new item for conflict handling is created with the ID WI-034, the next free ID after WI-033, and no existing ID is reused.
Its folder is nested directly inside WI-032's folder (work-items/WI-031-transaction-entry/WI-032-offline-sync/WI-034-<short slug>/), because it is a level 3 item: WI-031, then WI-032, then WI-034.
Its main file is named WI-034.md, and its folder has a references/ folder.
Its front matter has id WI-034 and parent WI-032, a State and Status pair, and no stage line, and its heading reads '# WI-034: ...'.
WI-034.md was made from the work item template, and no prompt is left in the fields it filled (such as <Work item title>).
WI-034's Related items line names [[WI-032]] as a link, not a folder path.
WI-032's Roadmap lists [[WI-034]] in the Sub-items cell of P2 — Sync, written as a link, and that cell no longer says 'None.'.
WI-032 gets a new Recent History row at the top of its table that names the new sub-item.
No fourth-level item is created: there is no item folder inside WI-034's folder, and no WI-035 exists.
The timestamp comparison is added as a task under a phase in WI-034's Tasks section, with a task ID such as P1-T01 and the Work, Deliverable, Done when, and Depends on lines.
The reply tells Mike in about one line that a sub-item under WI-034 would be a fourth level, which is not allowed, so the timestamp comparison is a task instead.
No item other than WI-032 and the new WI-034 is changed, and the agent runs no git add on anything under work-items/.
